map.评估探测器的检出率与误报率。: Assess a detector's detection rate and false-positive rate.
map.：100 个含缺陷样本检出 95 个：检出率 = 95÷100×100 = 95: : 95 detected out of 100 samples with defects: detection rate = 95÷100×100 = 95%, and the 5 misses need review or higher gain.
map.：正常工件读数均值 50、标准差 5，取 3σ = 65 为报警线：超 65 判: : normal parts average 50 with a standard deviation of 5, so 3σ = 65 is the alarm line: above 65 is suspect, balancing misses against false alarms.
map.检出率和误报率怎么权衡？: How do detection rate and false-positive rate trade off?
map.提高阈值降误报但升漏检，降低则反之；安全关键件倾向低漏检（高误报可接受复检）。: Raising the threshold reduces false positives but raises misses; lowering it does the opposite. Safety-critical parts favour low miss rates (a high false-positive rate is acceptable because of retesting).
map.正态分布下 3σ 外概率约 0.27%，作报警线误报低；但缺陷分布非正态时需按经: Under a normal distribution the probability beyond 3σ is about 0.27%, so it makes a low-false-alarm alarm line; when the defect distribution is non-normal, adjust empirically.
